Name: Better Kart GUI
Author: laycehund
Description:
This mod is an overhaul to the cart warp menu (in vanilla, a choose option dialogue box), whenever you have more than 10 warp locations scrolling through all the pages becomes tedious, this mod fixes this problem, if you are playing with the base game, this mod is probably not for you, but this is a great quality of life mod if you hate scrolling through a list and want to make things a little more convenient.


This mod is not finished yet, and was not very thoroughly tested, as such, if you have any issues or find any bugs, please report it!. This mod does not add any content to the game and it is just a user interface mod.


Source: [url=https://gitlab.com/layce/better-kart-gui]Gitlab[/url]
